description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteConnectionResponse class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.connectivity.modify package. It verifies equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path functionalities for DeleteConnectionResponse.

classes.name: DeleteConnectionResponseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteConnectionResponse for verifying equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and resource path functionalities.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of DeleteConnectionResponse work as expected using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that instances of DeleteConnectionResponse are immutable and that ConnectionId is also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as ConnectionId throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that a JSON object is correctly parsed into a DeleteConnectionResponse instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the DeleteConnectionResponse instance serializes back to the expected JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the resource path returned by the response is an empty JSON pointer.

calls: assertThatExceptionOfType(NullPointerException.class).isThrownBy(() -> DeleteConnectionResponse.of(null, DittoHeaders.empty())).withMessage("The %s must not be null!", "Connection ID")
